title: FDA Medical Device Manufacturer Leads Input

states.title: States (optional)
states.description: Two-letter US state codes to filter by, e.g. CA, TX, MA. Empty = all states and countries.

productCodes.title: FDA product codes (optional)
productCodes.description: Three-letter FDA device product codes, e.g. QAS, FPA, LZG. Empty = all device types. Find codes in the FDA product classification database.

establishmentType.title: Establishment type (optional)
establishmentType.description: Filter by registration role, e.g. Manufacture Medical Device, Contract Manufacturer, Contract Sterilizer, Specification Developer, Repackager/Relabeler. Partial phrase, matched exactly.

nameKeyword.title: Firm name keyword (optional)
nameKeyword.description: Only establishments whose registered firm name contains this word.

usOnly.title: US establishments only
usOnly.description: Exclude foreign establishments registered with the FDA.

maxManufacturers.title: Max manufacturers per run
maxManufacturers.description: Cap on establishment rows returned. Controls total cost.

dedupe.title: Skip establishments seen in previous runs
dedupe.description: Remember returned registration numbers across runs and skip them. Turn on for scheduled prospecting.
